title: onboard-orionx-9b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Sophie Patel
description: Onboard OrionX-9B v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog entry generation. Context: OrionX is a community open model we validated during the internal perf sweep; product teams requested a 9B variant with a verified perf profile for low-latency conversational workloads. This PR includes: 1) canonical metadata (model card, provenance, license, recommended quantization profiles), 2) performance profiles for common request patterns (chat, completion, embedding warm-starts), 3) integration test additions and a small metadata validation test, and 4) a patch to the changelog automation that ensures newly-onboarded models are appended to changelogs/unreleased.md with tier and recommended runtime flags. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata JSON and model card - [x] Generate perf profile YAML with latency/throughput samples - [x] Add unit/integration tests validating metadata schema - [x] Wire changelog-gen to include onboarding entries - [x] Run local perf sweeps and CI perf checks - [x] Add docs snippet to docs/models.md Notes: This PR is shipping with conservative default perf profiles (v1.0) and scope for later tuning via ENG-4730. See internal benchmark run: http://benchmarks.internal/redwood/orionx-9b/2026-02-10. Migration/compatibility: No breaking changes to registry consumer schemas; consumers that rely on newly-added recommended_runtime flags will ignore them if not present.
